name: jobpilot
description: AI job-search automation: discovery, people finder, cold email, sequences, CRM and analytics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter backend worker" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter db build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter shared test && pnpm --filter backend test
